notes.title: Version 1.4 Update
notes.content:
The previous『NPC Souls』1.3 update had a couple of bugs. 
They're finally hereby fixed! ːohrpgharoldː ːohrpgluciusː ːohrpgmarshaː ːohrpgthereseː ːohrpgralphː

A list of fixes:

- A crash when collecting the Uber Hammer.
- A crash when completing a stage for players who started playing before the NPC SOUL update.
- Equipped items are now upgradeable from the Items menu.
- NP are now properly gained from certain (boss) fights.

HUGE apology for the delay! I was unable to work for a couple of months starting October/November due to personal health-related reasons. Then when I was finally able to work again, it took some time to catch up on everything and to get a proper understanding of what needed to be fixed.

Hopefully this update fixes everything necessary. If there's still something off, please post it here and I'll get back to you as soon as possible:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/421810/discussions/0/133258593387834363/

Thank you so much for your patience! Enjoy OH! RPG! ːohrpgdonː

notes.title: Version 1.3:『NPC Souls』!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11026664/28ad7c00d2d45f07bab2793345d9900cb397448f.png[/img]

『NPC Souls』

Acquire NPC Points from battles & quests to upgrade your Soul & to gain special powers for the next fight! Souls carry over between stages, allowing you to use your previously gained EXP and LVs for the current stage!

Up to 3 NPC Souls may be equipped at a time. Complete certain chapters to gain more slots!

Collect all NPC Souls and become the most powerful!!

Version 1.3 Notes

- Battle Retry bug fixed.
- Steam Achievements bug fixed.
- Anti-lag option added for the church/bathhouse.
- New Status Menu.
- NPC Souls feature added.

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update; Game Performance Improved*
notes.content:
OH! RPG! has received a massive performance update today! 

If you ever experienced lag or other issues with the game, please run the game again and you will be able to play properly! ːohrpgralphː

A list of updates:

- Increased performance.
- Audio lag fixed.
- User Interface improvement.
- Hero call efficiency has been increased (they decline to help less frequently).
- Mouse support added to the world map.
- Food not healing the player when cursed has been fixed.

Please look forward to an additional update later this month which will add a new gameplay element called 『NPC SOUL』!
Some players have voiced their concern about the lack of experience points and items carrying over between chapters. The NPC SOUL system will allow you to call upon the gained power of NPCs from other chapters!
Additionally, Hero Calls will also increase the NPC SOUL, making them even more useful!

This is all in preparation for the official OH! RPG! DLC which will add 6 new chapters.

Thank you! Please enjoy the update! ːohrpgdonː ːohrpgmarshaː

*13 September 2016: Version 1.2b update released to fix a new issue with the Hero Calls.
